title: Certify fixed-profile helper-split first-crossing ceilings for #7000 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite certificates, no κ change. On the complete #7000 invoice, balanced refinement gives the largest first crossing on 0 ≤ κ ≤ 0.02 when each original helper may have at most m final pieces. The m=2 crossing is approximately 0.004689286593684114 and the full rank-one crossing is approximately 0.011115356648105199. Paid jobs and all main-origin targets stay fixed.

```text
one original rank-r helper, repeated in 18 LOCALs
  replace r with a positive integer partition (a_i), sum a_i = r
  raw margin gain = 18 * (sum a_i^(1-kappa) - r^(1-kappa))
  maximize pointwise with balanced min(m,r) pieces
  certify the first root with outward integer intervals
```

The new source-specific results are the nine-row ceiling ladder, all 87 nontrivial partitions of ranks 2–9, their per-helper exchange rates and the exact minimum touched-helper counts at two comparison prices. At the fixed complex wrapper price 0.00376669, the minima are 43 with arbitrary partitions and 137 with at most two final pieces. At paired BIT ordinary price 0.00385248 they are 68 and 218. Rank-nine stock suffices in all four relaxed plans.

The scope is deliberately the first crossing on [0,0.02]. A global single-crossing extension would be false: the fully split margin is positive again at κ=1. This qualification was posted in the [progress finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19537529), following the [original claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19530156).

## Evidence

- Before: the pinned invoice has raw crossing 0.003630058174688367… and rank surplus 1,520.
- After: exact integer intervals certify every ladder and single-split root with a rational bracket of width 2×10^-45. The exchange table proves each integer threshold by opposite signs at n−1 and n. The minimum-helper argument compares every helper rank and verifies available stock.
- Independent combinations enumeration agrees with all rank-1…9 partitions; 436 exact majorization cases corroborate the balancing proof. Integer 100th powers check every rank enclosure at κ=1/100. Six controls pass in normal and optimized modes.
- CPython 3.12.15 direct normal and optimized commands pass locally, about 2.4 seconds each. The registered package replay passes both commands. Static compilation passes. `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` passes at `777b642e85eb81564d1774e4747cb2313f0b54ec`, including source-history ancestry and executable modes.

From the repository root, using the standard library:

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/helper-split-headroom-ladder/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/helper-split-headroom-ladder/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/helper-split-headroom-ladder
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/helper-split-headroom-ladder --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected scientific marker is `PASS_HELPER_SPLIT_HEADROOM_LADDER`, with `pin_any=43 pin_binary=137 paired_any=68 paired_binary=218 controls=6`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Limitations and credit

This is an optimistic invoice relaxation, not a word, a legal split, supplier admission or a multiplication theorem. Pivot/cut/boundary bases, independence, ADD/SCALE costs, the ordinary bill, compiler/native admission and outer gates remain separate obligations. No selected-source cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. In particular, the paired BIT comparison price is not automatically available to the complex wrapper.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Jerry Chen / CubeJerry's #7000 invoice and #6980 caller, DreamingOfClouds's #6936/#6937, Ali Romman's helper-splitting method, dillona, ToikY, Rohan Arun and the retained P104 lineage. Classical balanced-partition optimality is already recorded in #6651 and is not claimed as new. zxv's #5554 concerns a different fixed-local-bill path model. Exact sources and hashes are in SOURCES.json. Predecessor files and notices are unchanged.

## Open next questions

- Can legal rank-nine 5+4 splits with no added paid rank approach the 137-helper wrapper threshold? Begin with an exact prefix/suffix witness and complete correction/restoration costs.
- How does a particular successor paid profile alter the ladder? Authenticate its helper-origin decomposition before substituting it into this model.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At head `777b642e85eb81564d1774e4747cb2313f0b54ec`, [run 42984445251](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42984445251), [plan job 130402173676](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42984445251/job/130402173676), failed in "Onboarding helper tests". I read the checks once and the job log directly. The log reports 760 tests, exactly one failure and 24 skipped:

```text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
AssertionError: '`make frontier7000-verify`' not found
```

The package `replay` job was skipped because `plan` failed. Local checks described above are the package's verification evidence; hosted CI supplied no scientific certification.

The mismatch is present in canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while the current section of `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. I read both base files and confirmed that this PR changes neither file nor the failing test. No unrelated fix, retrigger commit or job rerun was made.
